prompt: Implement the approved narrow Rig authentication companion for T12b. Preserve endpoint paths/payloads and existing UI behavior. Do not edit agent-core, onboarding or unrelated desktop files; do not generate unrelated features, commit, merge or publish. Return the required ticket JSON report with checks marked unrun until coordinator runs them.
